xmldoc.short_description: Create durations from minutes or convert durations to minutes.

param_input_item.param_description: Numeric minute counts or duration arrays.

param_output_item.param_description: A duration array for numeric input, or double minute counts for duration input.

description.p: Create durations from minutes or convert durations to minutes.
minutes stores elapsed time as seconds internally and provides convenient construction and extraction in minute units.
Array-valued inputs keep their data shape when the operation supports arrays. Scalar operands are expanded where the implementation defines scalar expansion.
